notes: Year: the statewide canje (235 pesos) ran in the first half of 2024, extended to 28 Jun 2024 (UnoTV, May 2024). The program decrees may be in the Periódico Oficial (Dec 2022 and Jan/Mar 2023 issues), so the design may date from 2023. No official image was found.
